desc: Rooftop restaurant in an upscale hotel offering Italian cuisine & cocktails with a city view.
addr: 4th Floor, at, Sheraton Grand, Brigade Gateway, Dr Rajkumar Rd, A Block, Rajajinagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560055, India

rev.t: Hideout Bar & Kitchen at Sheraton is a great spot to unwind. 🍸✨ Spacious, peaceful, and perfect for larger groups. A lovely place to relax, catch up, and enjoy a laid-back evening. …

Very quiet , we loved the live music , food was really amazing and also their signature cocktails , place is located on  the roof but it's completely covered and we can't see any of the city, I'd suggest going to the Persian terrace for a wonderful view of the city and sky

I don’t know how this restaurant is even part of Sheraton. The menu had very few options. Only few food items are there to order. And also the food that I ordered wasn’t tasty. It was just cooked and presented super nicely. Then …
